question.en: How will the Dedicated Freight Corridors contribute to reducing the logistics cost in India? Discuss.
question.hi: How will the Dedicated Freight Corridors contribute to reducing the logistics cost in India? Discuss.

modelAnswer.en: DFCs reduce logistics costs by: 1. Increasing average speed of freight trains. 2. Allowing higher axle loads. 3. Decongesting existing tracks for passenger trains. 4. Promoting multi-modal integration.
